$comment: Machine-readable module ownership and dependency map (FBL-010). The dependency-cruiser config derives its allowed-dependency rules FROM this file and scripts/check-architecture-manifest.ts keeps it honest against the real workspace manifests — one source of truth, no silent drift. Human-readable companion: docs/architecture/MODULE-OWNERSHIP.md.

@dealer/contracts.purpose: Framework-neutral shared contract types: role vocabulary, tenant context, envelopes, the internal Problem Details model.

@dealer/platform.purpose: Validated configuration, request/correlation context, structured PII-safe logging, error primitives, Problem Details mapping, JWT verification.

@dealer/database.purpose: PostgreSQL pool, query and transaction infrastructure. Migrations live at the repository root and are order-governed; this package never defines schema.

@dealer/fixed-ops.purpose: Sole owner of the service-cockpit domain and application behavior: RO state machine, authorization rules, step-up security, the legacy service implementation and metrics aggregation.
@dealer/fixed-ops.status: active — legacy/ is an explicitly mixed application/persistence component until FBL-060

@dealer/test-kit.purpose: Shared test utilities: destructive-test guards, world builders, fixtures. Test-only.
prohibited: being imported by any production package or app

@dealer/ui.purpose: UI primitives boundary. Structural shell only in FBL-010.

@dealer/api.purpose: Composition root for the service-cockpit HTTP API: server startup, middleware order, route mounting, health/metrics, graceful shutdown, envelope rendering.

@dealer/worker.purpose: Background process. Runs the FBL-020-R4 section 4 support-access expiry transition on a bounded interval; no queues, outbox or schedulers (FBL-040).
prohibited: queues, outbox tables and schedulers until FBL-040
@dealer/worker.status: active — deployed beside the API; runs the support-access expiry job

@dealer/web.purpose: Web application structural shell. No customer product UI in FBL-010.

@dealer/organization.purpose: Canonical internal organization hierarchy: Tenant, DealerGroup, LegalEntity, Rooftop, Department; hierarchy validation, effective-status resolution, organization repositories and ports.

@dealer/inventory.purpose: Release Train 2 vehicle acquisition and inventory: the acquisition party, the canonical VIN-identified vehicle, its stock identity and lifecycle, acquisition documents and costs, merchandising (versioned pricing, media, features, holds, transfers, aging) and listing publication reconciled through bounded provider adapters.
@dealer/inventory.database: owns the Release Train 2 vehicle, party, stock, merchandising and listing tables (migration 062)

@dealer/crm.purpose: CRM, BDC and marketing: lead intake and identity, routing, lifecycle and SLA, the shared activity and appointment timeline, consent-safe campaigns with suppression rechecked at send time, and deterministic versioned attribution up to the sales handoff.
prohibited: sales, showroom, desking, deal or F&I logic

@dealer/identity-access.purpose: Provider-neutral identity contracts, the WorkOS adapter (SDK confined to src/provider/workos), UserLink, sessions, RoleBinding, policy evaluation and PolicyDecision evidence, reauthentication transactions/grants, support-access requests and sessions.
prohibited: WorkOS SDK types in the public API
